name: jax-dev
description: Claude Code plugins for pure-JAX Gemma 4 rigs on Cloud TPU and AWS Inferentia2: one plugin per rig directory, each with its own management skill and MCP server named after the directory.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-v6e1-2b-w4a16
plugins.description: Pure-JAX Gemma 4 E2B QAT W4A16 (google/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-w4a16-ct) on one Cloud TPU v6e chip via queued resources: the original engine, formerly xbill9/tpu-jax. Management skill tpu-jax-v6e1-2b-w4a16-management, MCP tools prefixed mcp__tpu-jax-v6e1-2b-w4a16__.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-v6e1-2b-q4w4a16
plugins.description: Pure-JAX Gemma 4 E2B with the QAT Q4_0 grid repacked to W4A16 (xbill9/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-q4_0-w4a16-ct-text) on one Cloud TPU v6e chip, the engine of tpu-jax-v6e1-2b-w4a16 with only the checkpoint changed. Management skill tpu-jax-v6e1-2b-q4w4a16-management, MCP tools prefixed mcp__tpu-jax-v6e1-2b-q4w4a16__.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-v5e1-2b-q4w4a16
plugins.description: The v5e-1 sibling of tpu-jax-v6e1-2b-q4w4a16: the same pure-JAX engine, checkpoint (xbill9/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-q4_0-w4a16-ct-text) and server.py, with tpu.env set to one Cloud TPU v5e chip in us-west4-a. Management skill tpu-jax-v5e1-2b-q4w4a16-management, MCP tools prefixed mcp__tpu-jax-v5e1-2b-q4w4a16__.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-v5e1-2b
plugins.description: The bf16 baseline for the 2B repack rigs: google/gemma-4-E2B-it on one Cloud TPU v5e chip, the same pure-JAX engine and server.py as tpu-jax-v5e1-2b-q4w4a16. A separate rig from gemma4-dev's tpu-jax-v5e1-2b. Management skill tpu-jax-v5e1-2b-management, MCP tools prefixed mcp__tpu-jax-v5e1-2b__.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-v5e1-4b-w4a16
plugins.description: Pure-JAX Gemma 4 E4B QAT W4A16 (google/gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-w4a16-ct) on one Cloud TPU v5e chip, formerly xbill9/tpu-jax-4b. Management skill tpu-jax-v5e1-4b-w4a16-management, MCP tools prefixed mcp__tpu-jax-v5e1-4b-w4a16__.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-v6e1-12b-w4a16
plugins.description: Pure-JAX port of Gemma 4 12B QAT W4A16 (google/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-w4a16-ct) to TPU v6e-1, formerly xbill9/tpu-jax-12b. Measurements live in gemma4-dev's artifact rig of the same name. Management skill tpu-jax-v6e1-12b-w4a16-management, MCP tools prefixed mcp__tpu-jax-v6e1-12b-w4a16__.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-v6e1-26b-q4_0
plugins.description: Pure-JAX port of Gemma 4 26B A4B Q4_0, verified on CPU only, targeting TPU v6e-1; formerly xbill9/tpu-jax-26b. Its server.py still targets MCP SDK 1.x. Management skill tpu-jax-v6e1-26b-q4_0-management, MCP tools prefixed mcp__tpu-jax-v6e1-26b-q4_0__.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-v6e1-31b-w4a16
plugins.description: Pure-JAX port of Gemma 4 31B QAT W4A16 (google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-w4a16-ct) to TPU v6e-1, formerly xbill9/tpu-jax-31b. Measurements live in gemma4-dev's artifact rig of the same name. Management skill tpu-jax-v6e1-31b-w4a16-management, MCP tools prefixed mcp__tpu-jax-v6e1-31b-w4a16__.

plugins.name: tpu-jax-inf2-2b-w4a16
plugins.description: Pure JAX on AWS Inferentia2 (jax-neuronx) for Gemma 4 E2B QAT W4A16, formerly xbill9/tpu-jax-inf2. Two MCP servers: the AWS Inf2 server under the rig name, and the bundled Google Cloud TPU template as tpu-jax-inf2-2b-w4a16-tpu. Management skill tpu-jax-inf2-2b-w4a16-management, MCP tools prefixed mcp__tpu-jax-inf2-2b-w4a16__.

plugins.name: tpu-jaxrust-v5e1-2b
plugins.description: Gemma 4 E2B (google/gemma-4-E2B-it, bf16) with the forward pass written in Rust, emitted as StableHLO and run through libtpu's PJRT plugin on one Cloud TPU v5e chip (PyO3 module jaxrust_rs). Parity and speed against tpu-jax-v5e1-2b in its benchmarks. Management skill tpu-jaxrust-v5e1-2b-management, MCP tools prefixed mcp__tpu-jaxrust-v5e1-2b__.
